subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min product orientation — two choices requested
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@orionhealth.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, May 2, 2028 at 13:12 GMT
Subject: Post-discovery: quick scheduling + stakeholders

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — helpful conversation. We‘d like to schedule a short 30‑minute product orientation to show key stakeholders what Redwood can do for our inference workloads and to validate fit. Target attendees on our side: Tom Harper (Product), Nina Gomez (Security), Raj Patel (Platform). Procurement may observe.

Could you propose two (preferably three) options next week that include at least one morning ET slot? Also:
- Please include a short agenda (30 minutes) and any pre-reads you recommend.
- We‘d like the session to include a brief section on security/compliance (SaaS controls, VPC/private options) — Nina will lead that portion on our side.

I attached a quick spreadsheet with our top requirements (initial_requirements.xlsx) so you can tailor the demo.

Best,
Sara Lin
Director of IT
Orion Health

Attachment: initial_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)

From: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@orionhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, May 2, 2028 at 17:35 GMT
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: quick scheduling + stakeholders

Hi Sara —

Really glad the discovery was useful — appreciate the requirements doc. Happy to run a 30‑minute orientation focused on: short overview (5 min), demo of latency/cost controls (12 min), security/Q&A (8 min), next steps & MAP (5 min). I attached a one‑pager agenda (30min-demo-agenda.pdf).

Proposed slots (all 30 minutes) — pick the best two and we‘ll lock the first:
- Option A: Tue, May 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM ET (our default SRE + solutions engineer available)
- Option B: Wed, May 11 — 3:00–3:30 PM ET
- Option C: Thu, May 12 — 9:30–10:00 AM ET

From Redwood: I (Maya) will run the product portion and Karthik Iyer (cc‘d) will cover architecture + security integration touches. Two asks from your side:
1) Please nominate a Tech Escort who can speak to your infra constraints and run small live‑demo checks if needed (we‘ll keep them to a 5‑minute warm‑up).
2) If procurement will require an SOW or redline prior to the call, flag procurement@orionhealth.com and we can pre-share the standard SOW template.

If these windows are tight we can open an alternate afternoon on May 13.

Thanks — will hold the three options tentatively until we hear back.

– Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com

Attachment: 30min-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@orionhealth.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Harper <tom.harper@orionhealth.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@orionhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@orionhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, May 3, 2028 at 08:47 GMT
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: quick scheduling + stakeholders

Thanks Maya — Option A (Tue, May 10 10:00–10:30 AM ET) works best for the group.

Two quick notes:
- Procurement is cc‘d; they may request the SOW or standard terms prior to the demo — we‘ll try to keep that light, but wanted to surface it.
- We‘d like a 1–2 page pre‑read focusing on security controls and data isolation (Nina‘s ask). If you can share that before EOD Monday that would be great.

Also, Raj will act as our Tech Escort for the demo. He may ask to run a quick check of any network connectivity or allowlisting requirements just before the call — is 5 minutes prior to the start OK?

Finally, is it possible to record the session for internal review? If so, please note it in the invite.

Appreciate it — we‘ll expect the calendar invite and pre‑read.

Best,
Sara
